author: reek
body: The lighting pass of deferred shading. It reads the G-buffer written by GbufKernel -- albedo, normal, and hit distance -- reconstructs each pixel's world position from the distance and its view ray, and accumulates twenty coloured point lights orbiting the sphere cluster. Because shading reads the G-buffer rather than re-tracing, adding lights costs one loop iteration each -- the deferred advantage. The light loop is a tail-recursive fold lowered to a WGSL loop. Reference site's "deferred shading" technique.
